source.label: B
source.calibration: Unknown; the user-approved photographic appearance, not physical colorimetry.

sampling.coordinates: Original image pixels, half-open rectangles; no white-balance/exposure/saturation correction.

background.method: Most frequent RGB in an interior unmarked patch

foreground.method: Highest sRGB-relative luminance among pixels with G>=235, G>=2R, G>1.25B; avoids averaging line edges into the emitted color

uiDerivation.method: Decode sRGB, multiply all linear RGB channels by the same factor, encode and round to 8-bit. No white mixing or alpha blending.
uiDerivation.note: UI relief/syntax shades are functional derivatives, not additional measured CRT states. Text on the main green field is not dimmed; hierarchy uses weight and underlining.

contrast.note: The approved photograph has an illuminated green field. Its exact background cannot support 4.5:1 light text even with pure white; do not claim AA/AAA or quietly replace the field with black.
